title: Steinman fired by Lockheed after his book

tellings.quote: and he was warned that you don't that they didn't really like employees writing books on flying saucers. Couple days after the book came out, he got canned.

plain: A Lockheed employee named Bill Steinman is said to have been fired a couple of days after his book on flying saucers came out, around 1986. Scott Ramsey, a researcher of UFO crash stories, tells Michels that Steinman had been warned that the company 'didn't really like employees writing books on flying saucers,' and then 'he got canned.' Told this way, it suggests the defense industry punishes insiders who write about UFOs.
